headline: RBI deletes limits on non-option derivative contracts for Small Finance Banks
summary_points: RBI issues the Small Finance Banks - Miscellaneous Amendment Directions, 2026 under section 35A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
Section C 'Limits for Non-Option Derivative Contracts' in Chapter IV (paragraph 37) of the 2025 Directions stands deleted.
The amendment comes into effect immediately upon issuance, i.e. October 19, 2026.
The notification does not state what replaces the deleted limits; SFBs should check other applicable derivative norms.
who_is_affected: Small Finance Banks that deal in non-option (non-option derivative) contracts, and their compliance, treasury and risk teams.
action_required: SFBs should update internal derivative policies and limit frameworks to reflect deletion of paragraph 37 and confirm any other applicable RBI derivative guidelines.

Key change: Section C on 'Limits for Non-Option Derivative Contracts' in Chapter IV of the SFB Miscellaneous Directions, 2025 (paragraph 37) stands deleted.

The Directions are issued under section 35A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, and take effect immediately upon issuance.

Why it matters:
- SFB treasury and risk teams should revisit internal limit frameworks for non-option derivatives.
- Board-approved derivative policies may need to be aligned with the amended Directions.
- The notification does not say what replaces the deleted section, so other applicable RBI derivative norms should be reviewed.
